text:
Jared (AE): kicking off here — Montara Health pilot: want to lock down 3 core user flows, success criteria, and any enterprise/security blockers by EOD Fri. They care about PHI handling, SLAs, and cost.
Tom (SE): noted. can we list the concrete endpoints they need? helps with perf + pricing estimates.
Jared (AE): top asks from kickoff: 1) Nurse triage assistant (chat + summarization), 2) Post-visit note draft (structured output), 3) Claims summarization for billing team (redaction required).
Priya (SE): ok. mapping to endpoints: 
- /v1/chat/triage -> streaming chat (short context, low latency)
- /v1/generate/note -> structured json output (sections: HPI, A/P)
- /v1/summarize/claims -> batch summarization + PII redaction

Tom (SE): can you paste the sample request shape for the note endpoint? I want to validate token usage.
Priya (SE): sure: ```json
{
  "patient_id":"<id>",
  "visit_notes":["raw transcript text..."],
  "output_schema":{ "history":"string","assessment":"string","plan":"string" }
}```
Jared (AE): Montara insists on no raw transcripts stored on our side for >24h. they prefer VPC private deployment or dedicated capacity.
Sofia (PM): success metrics proposal:
- Triage: p95 latency <300ms, accuracy of routing >=92% on eval set
- Note gen: section F1 >=0.85 vs gold summaries, format compliance 99%
- Claims: PII redaction recall >=0.99, summary compression ratio target 10x
Also SLA: 99.9% uptime during business hours for pilot, and audit logs retained 90 days.
Tom (SE): for 99.9% during business hours we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity). Hosted could work if we set automatic fallback but might hit QoS on peak.
Jared (AE): pricing question from procurement — monthly estimate for pilot (100k tokens/day avg across endpoints). Can you give rough TCO?
Tom (SE): rough calc: at 100k tokens/day ~3M tokens/mo. On hosted with our standard price band that maps to ~$Xk/mo. Dedicated upfront commit would be higher but predictable and gives VPC + retention. I'll DM numbers to procurement.
Priya (SE): security checklist items from Montara: SOC2, HIPAA BAA, KMS customer-managed keys, network isolation, and no long-term storage of PHI. OpsBot: security questionnaire PDF uploaded to their workspace: https://files.company/secure/montara_scb_q1.pdf
Sofia (PM): evaluation plan for quality: we need 50 recorded triage dialogs + 200 gold notes + 300 claims to run offline evals. Can engineering help instrument synthetic prompt sets to test edge cases?
Priya (SE): yes — we'll produce a 200-sample eval harness next week. For triage we'll run A/B versus rule-based baseline.
Tom (SE): infra checklist: can we support streaming with prefix caching for note drafts to reduce cost? Priya said yes; we should enable prefix/KV caching on the triage/chat route.
Jared (AE): compliance/legal want data flow diagram and a one-pager on retention & deletion flows. Priya can you draft?
Priya (SE): will do. draft by Wed COB. includes: ephemeral transcript ingestion -> tokenization -> model inference (no persisted transcript) -> transient cache TTL=60s -> structured note persisted to Montara's S3 (customer-owned).
Sofia (PM): rollout plan: Week 0-1: infra + security signoff, Week 2: internal eval + A/B, Week 3: pilot alpha with 5 clinicians, Week 4-6: expand to 50 clinicians and measure metrics.
Jared (AE): blockers: 1) signed BAA, 2) KMS integration timeline, 3) list of PII fields for redaction. Montara legal to provide examples by Tue.
Tom (SE): action items — I'll prepare dedicated vs hosted cost options and latency projections (owner: Tom, due Tue).
Priya (SE): I'll deliver eval harness + data flow doc + sample payloads (owner: Priya, due Wed).
Sofia (PM): I'll own success criteria doc and pilot roadmap (owner: Sofia, due Thu).
Jared (AE): I'll push procurement + legal follow-ups and collect sample data (owner: Jared, due Tue).
OpsBot: note created in #sales-pilot-tracking: https://tracker/issue/INC-4892 (automated)
Jared (AE): thanks team. quick ask — can we set canary to 10% traffic and auto-fallback to smaller model if p99 latency >800ms?
Priya (SE): yes, we can set routing policy: prefer v1-large, fallback to v1-medium. will include in rollout config.
Tom (SE): one more: monitoring — we need token-level cost dashboard and per-route latency p95/p99 in Console. Ops/SEs should get alerts on >20% regression vs baseline.
Sofia (PM): agreed. adding alert thresholds to SLO doc.
Jared (AE): perfect. I'll update Montara with timeline and owners after this thread. :thumbsup:
Tom (SE): ack.
Priya (SE): ack.
Sofia (PM): ack.
